preToolUse.bash: p=""; for r in "$PLUGIN_ROOT" "$COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT" "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT" "."; do if [ -n "$r" ] && [ -f "$r/com.github.copilot/hooks/apex-hook.mjs" ]; then p="$r/com.github.copilot/hooks/apex-hook.mjs"; break; fi; done; if [ -n "$p" ]; then exec node "$p" preToolUse; fi; cat > /dev/null; echo "APEX hooks: plugin folder not found; reinstall the APEX plugin." >&2; exit 0
preToolUse.powershell: $p = $null; foreach ($r in @($env:PLUGIN_ROOT, $env:COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT, $env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT, '.')) { if ($r) { $c = [System.IO.Path]::Combine($r, 'com.github.copilot/hooks/apex-hook.mjs'); if ([System.IO.File]::Exists($c)) { $p = $c; break } } }; $in = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd(); if ($p) { $in | node $p preToolUse; exit $LASTEXITCODE }; [Console]::Error.WriteLine('APEX hooks: plugin folder not found; reinstall the APEX plugin.'); exit 0
